correctness.rationale: Riemann--Hurwitz yields genus four and local valuations give the four explicit holomorphic forms. Exact p=11 coefficient extraction, independently recomputed by sparse symbolic and pure-binomial calculations, gives two scalar factors both vanishing exactly at the quadratic locus and an invertible two-dimensional Cartier block. Hence rank 4 or 2 and unchanged stable rank; the quadratic has discriminant 8 nonsquare in F11 and separable simple zeros, each double for the determinant.

value.rationale: This is a complete arithmetic rank stratification and scheme-theoretic Hasse intersection on a naturally distinguished one-dimensional genus-four special Hurwitz family. The all-parameters assertion and double-zero multiplicities provide strictly more than the known generic ordinary rank, possible Newton strata, or the existence of one equianharmonic special curve. This precise invariant is a natural input to specialization/intersection calculations on the marked Hurwitz line.
